$comment: The four liveries the hero car ships in, and one decision recorded rather than argued.
`gulf` and `martini` are two companies' trademarks, not generic colour schemes, and a livery is
far more identifying than a roofline — which is why everything else in assets.json goes to such
lengths to describe an era instead of a car. The point was put to Rich and he asked for them
anyway, alongside `rosso` and `midnight`. His call, his game; it is written down here so nobody
re-litigates it in six months, and so the four originals below stay available if it changes.
EACH LIVERY IS NOW ITS OWN MESH. `buildPrototype` applied a Livery as flat material colours, so
one model served four schemes; a reconstruction carries its paint in a baked texture and cannot
be tinted. `variants` on the hero spec generates one car per livery — see assets.json.

liveries.name: Gulf
liveries.paint: pale powder blue with a broad orange stripe over nose and roof

liveries.name: Martini
liveries.paint: off-white with a broad stripe of dark blue and red over nose and roof

liveries.name: Rosso
liveries.paint: vivid racing red with a broad cream stripe over nose and roof

liveries.name: Midnight
liveries.paint: near-black with a broad gold stripe over nose and roof

liveries.name: Salt flat
liveries.reads: A works white with a single deep maroon centre stripe. The plainest of the set and the one that best carries a number.

liveries.name: Kingfisher
liveries.reads: Deep marine blue with a cream stripe — the dark-blue-and-cream pairing an entrant used before sponsors bought the bodywork.

liveries.name: Sandline
liveries.reads: Bone with oxide red. Reads as a privateer who painted over last season's colours, which is what most of the field was.

liveries.name: Sunstrip
liveries.reads: Ochre with a near-black stripe. The loudest one, and the one that reads at sprite size against a blue sea.

$alternatives: The four below ship nothing today. They are kept because they carry the same period read without borrowing anyone's marks, and because the decision above is reversible.
